svg.text: Resource topology, managed-identity trust boundaries, and SQL role separation (worker / web / controller) across Azure AI Foundry, App Service, Container Apps, Azure SQL, and Fabric
Azure App Service — Triage Command Center
• Operator queue, incident records, run timelines, monitoring scopes, scenario validation
• Validates Entra ID JWT app-role claims (Reader, Operator, Approver, Admin)
• Writes queued human intents & approvals via checked SQL procedures
• Never dispatches Fabric or Power BI remediation directly from a browser request
• App Roles on Command Center SPA:
• Zero client secrets, keys, or SQL logins
Monitored Fabric & Power BI Workloads + Worker
• Deterministic DAX table scans: DataQuality.Check + baselines
• Silent-failure detection when refresh succeeds with 0/stale rows
• Scheduled job & activity runs: Pipeline.GetRun / QueryActivityRuns
• Notebook activity failures captured as correlated pipeline evidence
explicit human approval, and durable action reservation before POST
• App-owned Eventstream routes workspace job events to Event Hub
• Events are source hints; REST evidence + controller admission required
• Discovers domains, workspaces, semantic models & pipelines
• Polls Fabric/Power BI REST history & consumes Eventstream
• Submits observations via SQL worker.* procedures
• Holds read/event access only — cannot trigger refreshes or reruns
Shared Durable State — Azure SQL Database
Zero direct INSERT/UPDATE/DELETE grants on monitoring tables:
• Monotonic epoch & revision checks + record_retirement offsets
• Automatic retirement of superseded inventory & worker fact bindings
Control & Reasoning Plane — Azure AI Foundry
1. Reconciles worker observations, web intents & uncertain receipts
2. Claims leased monitoring work with workspace-fair rotation
3. Enforces PolicyLedger budgets (max 8 calls, 1 remediation, 1 post)
4. Refuses non-allowlisted tools; denials never spend remediation budget
5. Verifies unexpired, fingerprint-matched approval & atomic SQL fence
6. Dispatches permitted Power BI / Fabric / Graph / Teams API calls
7. Cross-checks model final outcome against recorded evidence; overrides
false resolved claims when deterministic scans fail
Only identity authorized to mutate authority or trigger Fabric actions
• Triage-Orchestrator: proposes allowlisted tool calls & structured
TriageOutcome from failure signatures + public Learn playbooks
• Triage-Observer: tool-free incident Q&A grounded on stored evidence
Least-privilege separation: Reasoning models hold zero Azure/Fabric credentials. The web portal and monitoring worker cannot execute remediations or write authority tables.
Default networking & identity: Public endpoints hardened by Entra-only authentication, TLS, SQL firewall admission, and JWT app-role claims (no client secrets, SQL logins, or VNet prerequisites).
